how.title: From file to first result
how.lead: For a typical Q&A file this usually takes a few minutes.

how.s2Text: A timed exam, step-by-step learning, mistake review or a live Battle.
how.s3Text: Average score, weak topics and focus time — updated after every session.

about.title: You have plenty of material to prepare with. What's missing is an easy way to test yourself on it.
about.p1: ExamR grew out of a student problem: teachers hand out Q&A files, but working with them never goes beyond reading from paper.
about.p2: We turn that file into interactive practice. You test yourself, see your mistakes and know what to spend time on next. The goal is simple: less time, more precise preparation.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Text-based PDF and Word (.docx) files up to 20 MB. Text can't be read from scanned, image-only PDFs.
faq.a2: No. The documents you upload are visible only to you. Only an admin can share material, with a group or with all users.
faq.q3: What if a question was recognised incorrectly?
faq.a3: You can edit your question in the question bank and mark it as “reviewed”. The change applies to your next exams.
faq.a4: ExamR is currently in its demo stage and free. Some features may change during this period.
faq.q5: Can I sign in with Google?
faq.a5: Yes. If you already have an account with the same email, sign in with your password first and link Google from your profile.
faq.q6: Who do I contact if something goes wrong?
faq.a6Before: If something goes wrong on the site or during an exam, write to
faq.a6After: . If you're signed in, you can also send a request with the “?” (Help and contact) button in the top bar.
